The day that comes after Monday is Tuesday.

The setting described in the text is the interior and immediate exterior of an ancient castle located in the Scottish Highlands. Specifically, the scene takes place within the castle's cool, echoic corridors, looking out towards the vast landscape of green hills and purple heather.
